key_insight: MedVTok introduces a shared visual token space for medical data, allowing both 2D images and 3D volumes from different imaging modalities to use a common representation.
problem_solved: Existing medical visual tokenizers are often limited to a particular imaging modality or dimensionality, creating fragmented representations that are difficult to reuse across multimodal systems.
method: Build a general-purpose visual tokenizer for heterogeneous medical imaging inputs.
Map 2D images and 3D volumes from diverse modalities into a unified token space.
Use this common visual interface to support multimodal patient-condition modeling.
impact: A shared tokenizer could simplify the integration of diverse medical imaging data and improve representation reuse across AI systems. The provided abstract is truncated, so implementation details and measured benefits are not available.
visual_elements: Converging pipeline: multiple medical imaging modalities → MedVTok → shared visual tokens.

paper_title: MedVTok: A General-Purpose Medical Visual Tokenizer
paper_authors: Chenglong Ma, Yuanfeng Ji, Junzhi Ning, Jiyao Liu, Yujie Wei
